title: People from certain countries visit 'specific' mallworlds
content: Something I noticed when reading some posts here is that Mallworld changes its 'appearance' depending on the country the person lives in The vast majority, at least some active members, are residents of North America, and some of the places visited have unique characteristics of places associated with shopping malls, restaurant chains and even public restrooms in North America That's why I would like to know if people from other countries also see this difference, as it could explain a lot For example, I'm from Brazil, and I haven't seen anyone here yet describing a mallworld like the one I visit frequently, a large bus station with lots of people, ramps and handrails, something that is characteristic of cities in Brazil
